additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425790-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313483122008] Unable To Recharge CRM:02889000007
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We are experiencing issues with charging at the Grugliasco outlet (ID: 313483122008).
The customer used their own cable and connected it to our Type 2 socket. In every attempt, the charging session starts but then stops after approximately one minute.
The customer tried the following:
the app using a Unicredit Mastercard: the transaction was unsuccessful.
With Apple Pay: the payment was authorized, but the charging stopped after one minute.
POS terminal: same issue occurred.
The customer also reports that the same problem happened three days ago.
We checked the station and found no active alarms.
Please let us know how to proceed.
Best regards,
Giuseppe
